Our Story & Beliefs

The Gospel We Stand On

First of All

“For I delivered unto you first of all that which I also received, how that Christ died for our sins according to the scriptures; and that he was buried, and that he rose again the third day according to the scriptures.” 1 Corinthians 15:3–4
I

Died

Christ died for our sins, taking on Himself what we could never pay.

II

Buried

He was truly laid in the grave. His death was real, and so is our hope.

III

Risen

He rose again the third day, and in Him we stand and are saved.

What We Believe

  • One God

    We believe in one God composed of three persons.

  • The Bible

    We believe the Bible is the Word of God, written not by the will of man, but by holy men of God as they were inspired by the Holy Spirit.

  • Jesus Christ

    We believe God the Son, Jesus Christ, created everything seen and unseen. He died for our sins, was buried, and rose again the third day.

Camp Springs is a nondenominational church. Pastor Steve would be happy to walk you through our full articles of faith. Get in touch.

Worship with us from anywhere

Whether you're traveling, homebound, or just getting to know us, you're welcome to be part of Sunday worship online.

  1. Visit our Facebook page a few minutes before the service starts.
  2. The live video appears at the top of the page once we go live.
  3. Missed it? Past services stay on the page, so you can watch anytime.

You don't need a Facebook account to watch, though following the page will notify you when we go live.
